message.content:
Below is a ready‑to‑run **gcloud** command that creates a new Compute Engine VM on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) with an NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.  
If you prefer the raw REST‑API payload, I’ve also supplied the equivalent JSON body that can be sent to `https://compute.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/instances`.

---

## 1️⃣ gcloud CLI Command

```bash
# Replace <PROJECT_ID> and <ZONE> with your own values
PROJECT_ID="my-gcp-project"
ZONE="us-central1-a"

# Create a VM named “rtx-a6000-demo” with:
# • 8 vCPU, 32 GB RAM (n1-standard-8)
# • 1 NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU
# • Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (focal)
# • Persistent boot disk (50 GB)
# • Allow SSH via default network
# • Enable GPU drivers automatically
gcloud compute instances create rtx-a6000-demo \
    --project=${PROJECT_ID} \
    --zone=${ZONE} \
    --machine-type=n1-standard-8 \
    --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-a6000,count=1 \
    --image-family=ubuntu-2004-lts \
    --image-project=ubuntu-os-cloud \
    --boot-disk-size=50GB \
    --boot-disk-type=pd-balanced \
    --metadata-from-file startup-script=startup.sh \
    --tags=http-server,https-server \
    --scopes=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform \
    --maintenance-policy=MIGRATE \
    --restart-on-failure
```

### What each flag does

| Flag | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `--machine-type` | CPU & memory allocation (`n1-standard-8` → 8 vCPU, 32 GiB RAM). |
| `--accelerator` | Adds GPUs (`nvidia-tesla-a6000`). |
| `--image-family` / `--image-project` | Installs Ubuntu 20.04 LTS from the official Ubuntu image repository. |
| `--boot-disk-size` / `--boot-disk-type` | Creates a 50 GB balanced SSD boot disk. |
| `--metadata-from-file startup-script=startup.sh` | Optional script to auto‑install NVIDIA drivers after boot. |
| `--tags` | Enables HTTP/HTTPS firewall rules if needed. |
| `--scopes` | Grants full Cloud Platform access (required for driver installation). |
| `--maintenance-policy=MIGRATE` | Allows live migration during maintenance windows. |
| `--restart-on-failure` | Auto‑restarts the instance if it crashes. |

#### Optional: Automatic Driver Installation

Create a simple `startup.sh` script that installs the NVIDIA driver:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-535
sudo reboot
```

Upload this script to your project’s bucket or reference it locally.

---

## 2️⃣ REST API Payload (JSON)

If you’re calling the Compute Engine REST API directly (e.g., via `curl` or a custom SDK), use the following JSON body. Replace placeholders (`{project}`, `{zone}`) with your actual values.

```json
{
  "name": "rtx-a6000-demo",
  "machineType": "projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/machineTypes/n1-standard-8",
  "disks": [
    {
      "boot": true,
      "autoDelete": true,
      "initializeParams": {
        "diskSizeGb": 50,
        "diskType": "projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/diskTypes/pd-balanced",
        "sourceImage": "projects/ubuntu-os-cloud/global/images/family/ubuntu-2004-lts"
      }
    }
  ],
  "networkInterfaces": [
    {
      "network": "global/networks/default",
      "accessConfigs": [
        { "type": "ONE_TO_ONE_NAT", "name": "External NAT" }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "scheduling": {
    "preemptible": false,
    "automaticRestart": true,
    "onHostMaintenance": "MIGRATE"
  },
  "guestAccelerators": [
    {
      "acceleratorCount": 1,
      "acceleratorType": "projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/acceleratorTypes/nvidia-tesla-a6000"
    }
  ],
  "serviceAccounts": [
    {
      "email": "default",
      "scopes": ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform"]
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {
    "items": [
      {
        "key": "startup-script",
        "value": "#!/bin/bash\napt-get update\napt-get install -y nvidia-driver-535\nreboot"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### How to POST this payload

```bash
curl -X POST \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth application-default print-access-token)" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d @instance.json \
     "https://compute.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/instances"
```

Replace `@instance.json` with the path to a file containing the JSON above.

---

## 3️⃣ Quick Checklist

- [ ] **Project ID** – Confirmed in your GCP console.  
- [ ] **Zone** – Choose a zone that supports RTX A6000 (e.g., `us-central1-a`, `us-east1-b`).  
- [ ] **Billing Enabled** – Ensure billing is active; GPU usage incurs extra charges.  
- [ ] **Firewall Rules** – If you need inbound traffic, add `allow-ssh` rule or use `--tags`.  
- [ ] **Driver Installation** – The startup script installs NVIDIA driver 535; adjust if newer drivers are required.  

Once the instance is running, you can SSH into it:

```bash
gcloud compute ssh rtx-a6000-demo --project=${PROJECT_ID} --zone=${ZONE}
```

Enjoy your RTX A6000 GPU on GCP!
